headword: {内閣改造|ないかくかいぞう}

definitions.explanation: The prime minister replacing some cabinet ministers while the cabinet itself stays in office. A staple of political news.

examples.japanese: {内閣改造|ないかくかいぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A cabinet reshuffle was carried out.

examples.japanese: {内閣改造|ないかくかいぞう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{外務大臣|がいむだいじん}→外務大臣：31791_gaimudaijin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In the cabinet reshuffle, a new foreign minister was appointed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{内閣改造|ないかくかいぞう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{踏|ふ}み{切|き}る→踏み切る：06237_fumikiru⟧⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧だ。
examples.english: The prime minister is expected to go ahead with a cabinet reshuffle as early as next month.

notes:
Unlike ⟦{組閣|そかく}→組閣：16543_sokaku⟧ (forming a new cabinet), a reshuffle keeps the same government and replaces only some of its members.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内閣改造|ないかくかいぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to reshuffle the cabinet
- {内閣改造|ないかくかいぞう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{踏|ふ}み{切|き}る→踏み切る：06237_fumikiru⟧: to go ahead with a reshuffle
- {内閣改造|ないかくかいぞう}⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧: the appointments in a reshuffle
